subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Clever Gadget I’m Loving, TV Series I’m Bingeing, Food from Thin Air, and More

bullets.title: Food from Thin Air
bullets.creator: Sarah Kuta
bullets.note: . Teaser: “It sounds like science fiction, but Johns Hopkins scientists are making food from air. The revolutionary project could someday help feed soldiers in rugged, hard-to-reach places or sustain victims of natural disasters until normal supply chain operations can resume.”

bullets.title: Special Ops: Lioness
bullets.note:
I am a huge fan of [Taylor Sheridan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taylor_Sheridan), who co-created [_Yellowstone_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yellowstone_(American_TV_series)) and created its prequels [_1883_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1883_(TV_series)) and [_1923_](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1923_(TV_series)). I was introduced to his writing through [_Sicario_](https://www.amazon.com/gp/video/detail/amzn1.dv.gti.a6b886eb-47c1-90f9-7508-d37c218381bb?autoplay=0&ref_=atv_cf_strg_wb), for which he was nominated for the Writers Guild of America Award for Best Original Screenplay. He has the ability to weave deep character development and brutal reflections of reality into edge-of-your-seat story arcs that keep you watching. Here’s a portion of the official description: “_Special Ops: Lioness_ is based on a real-life program and follows Cruz Manuelos ([De Oliveira](https://www.instagram.com/laysladeo/)), a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine recruited to join the Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within.” The series stars [Zoe Saldaña](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoe_Salda%C3%B1a), [Laysla De Oliveira](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Laysla_De_Oliveira), [Michael Kelly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Kelly_(actor)), [Morgan Freeman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morgan_Freeman), and [Nicole Kidman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nicole_Kidman). It is not suitable for family viewing.  
​  
Watch the trailer [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3axWgmlwnl4).

bullets.title: Braun All-in-One Style Kit
bullets.note: Every once in a while, innovations come around that solve problems with a “Why didn’t someone think of this earlier?” effect. Luggage on wheels is one example. For me, this Braun trimmer is another. I have TONS of clippers. Why? Because I lose the plastic attachments for different lengths, then I’m screwed and need a new set. This superior Braun design is an all-in-one solution that uses a radial dial allowing 40 length settings in 0.02″ steps. I love it.

bullets.title: The STRONGEST Hobby Lifter Ever - Lifting Legends
Happy
bullets.creator: Daughters of Mara
bullets.note:
([Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/4VSaOyEHjWW7opStz9i9SN), [YouTube](https://youtu.be/TDWVCAotnp0?si=XTPVDyLbtTRFumtc)) by [Daughters of Mara](https://www.instagram.com/daughtersofmara/). This was sent to me by the one and only drumming monster [Dave Elitch](https://tim.blog/2018/11/26/dave-elitch/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf#content), whose savant-level percussion you’ll hear. [Shawn Zuzek](https://www.instagram.com/shawnzuzek/), lead singer of Daughters of Mara, offers some additional context on the song: “How do you find the balance between moments of feeling fully crushed and truly letting go? … ‘Happy’ is incredibly personal to me. It’s about a very specific person and a very specific place in time, but I think a lot of us can identify with trying to fight despair with progress and resilience and even grace. Life is hard and letting go is hard, but you accept and you grow. You wave goodbye, and even if you feel like you’re dying, you try to find a way to smile and tell that person - or that part of who you are - that you love them.”  
​  
​**Softer:  
“**[**Aguanta**](https://open.spotify.com/track/3zNUKKD6iFpxA1x3cavlDH?si=e2f3d60267cd4afd)**”** ([YouTube](https://youtu.be/txaNbo-__xc?si=UM0xgjTOS-3PjJ3f), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/3zNUKKD6iFpxA1x3cavlDH?si=e2f3d60267cd4afd), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/album/aguanta-single/1511987285)) by [Desta French](https://www.instagram.com/destafrench/?hl=en). Give this one 45 seconds to warm up. It’s audio caramel dripped on curves.
